name: Saved by the Band
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Daisy's (Miller Place) - live music calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Medium confidence: the Facebook page was matched by name, its "ny" handle and a 90s/2000s party-band description; it does not name Long Island towns in the public part. The website it lists (savedbythe.band) returned 403 Forbidden when we checked, so it is not recorded. A YouTube channel @SavedbytheBandny (2 subscribers, no description) likely belongs to the same band but was not confirmed. Other bands with this name exist (an Alanis Morissette/"lady jams" show at facebook.com/savedbytheband, a Los Angeles 90s band, and Instagram @_savedbytheband_ with an unconfirmed location) and should not be linked. Our record says it was auto-added from Daisy's Miller Place calendar, but the event page is for Daisy's Patchogue. No logo or photos (Facebook images need login).
description: A New York cover band that plays 90s and 2000s pop, rock, R&B and dance hits as a throwback party. It plays Long Island bars such as Daisy's in Patchogue.

evidence.note: Daisy's in Patchogue lists Saved by the Band for its American Saturday Nights on October 10, 7 PM, followed by a country DJ.

Public Facebook page "Saved by the Band" (handle savedbythebandny, musician/band) describes a 90s and 2000s throwback party band playing pop, rock, R&B and dance hits; it lists the site savedbythe.band.
A Long Island events guide lists "Saved By the Band live" in Franklin Square on April 17, 2026.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: daisysli.com, facebook.com, liblogger.com.
